finalText:
**Redis outage caused a cascading crash.**

At `02:14:07` `redis` connection dropped (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). See [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). `api` fell back to direct store reads, which triggered constant cache miss storms and timeouts.

Redis never came back. 12 reconnect attempts all failed, last one at `02:31:26` ([logs/app.log:716](logs/app.log:716)). Request queue depth climbed unbounded past its 500 max, hitting 568.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, then `api` went unresponsive and the supervisor killed the process group at `02:31:52` ([logs/app.log:719](logs/app.log:719)).

Root cause: `redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` went down and stayed down. Everything else is fallout from that.

Next: check why `redis` at `10.0.0.12` was unreachable.
